assumptions.condition: For every observed control cell, the observed failure time equals the control potential failure time \(T^0_{p,m,j}\).
The records \(O_{p,m,j}\) are mutually independent across observed cells and patient indices.

standard.name: Independent patient sampling across survival cohorts

assumptions.condition: Within each observed control cell, \(T^0_{p,m,j}\perp C_{p,m,j}\).
There is a fixed \(g_->0\) such that \(\inf_{p,m,t\in\mathcal I}G_{p,m}(t)\ge g_-\) over observed control cells.
There is a fixed \(s_->0\) such that \(\inf_{p,m,t\in\mathcal I}S^0_{p,m}(t)\ge s_-\).

standard.name: At-risk survival positivity on a truncated horizon

assumptions.condition: The control survival panel satisfies \(S^0_{p,m}(t)=s_p(t)+b_p(t)^\top z_m\) for every \(p\in\{0,1\}\), \(m\in\mathcal M\), and \(t\in\mathcal I\).

standard.name: Canonical affine form of the exact survival factor model

assumptions.condition: The primitive centered donor operator \(\mathcal C_D\) has exactly \(d=r-1\) nonzero singular directions, with rank zero interpreted literally when \(r=1\).
For fixed \(0<\gamma_-\le\gamma_+<\infty\), every nonzero singular value of \(\mathcal C_D\) lies in \([\gamma_-,\gamma_+]\) when \(d>0\).
For fixed \(0<\kappa_-\le\kappa_+<\infty\), every eigenvalue of \(\int_{\mathcal I}b_0(t)b_0(t)^\top\,dt\) lies in \([\kappa_-,\kappa_+]\) when \(d>0\).

definitions.name: Canonical normalized survival-factor coordinates
definitions.construction: Set \(s_p(t)=N_0^{-1}\sum_{m\in\mathcal D}S^0_{p,m}(t)\). Write the singular-value decomposition of the primitive centered operator as \(\mathcal C_D=\sum_{k=1}^d\sigma_k u_k\otimes v_k\), ordered by decreasing \(\sigma_k\) with deterministic sign and tie-breaking rules. Define \(z_{m,k}=\sqrt{N_0}v_{k,m}\) and \(b_{p,k}(t)=\sigma_k u_{k,p}(t)\), so \(N_0^{-1}\sum_{m\in\mathcal D}z_mz_m^\top=I_d\). Define the shared target coordinate \(z_\star\) by the unique coefficient equation \(S^0_{0,\star}-s_0=b_0^\top z_\star\). Then \(S^0_{p,m}(t)=s_p(t)+b_p(t)^\top z_m\), \(s_p(0)=1\), and \(b_p(0)=0\). When \(d=0\), all vectors, sums, and Gram matrices in this construction are zero-dimensional.

definitions.name: Exact-rank censored Synthetic Survival Control class
definitions.construction: \(\mathfrak P_r(N_0,K_T,K_D)=\{P_{N_0,K_T,K_D}: P_{N_0,K_T,K_D}\text{ satisfies }\mathrm{ass:control-consistency},\mathrm{ass:patient-independence},\mathrm{ass:independent-censoring},\mathrm{ass:censor-overlap},\mathrm{ass:event-overlap},\mathrm{ass:hazard-smoothness},\mathrm{ass:normalized-factor-model},\mathrm{ass:exact-centered-rank},\mathrm{ass:centered-contrast-spectrum},\mathrm{ass:pre-contrast-gram},\mathrm{ass:donor-incoherence},\mathrm{ass:target-loading-bound},\mathrm{ass:factor-envelope}\}\). Exact rank is imposed on the primitive operator \(\mathcal C_D\); for \(r=1\), its rank is zero and every contrast-space object uses the zero-dimensional convention.

definitions.name: Per-triple uniform continuous-time honesty class
definitions.construction: For each evaluated triple, define \(\mathcal H_r(N_0,K_T,K_D;\alpha)=\{B:\inf_{P\in\mathfrak P_r(N_0,K_T,K_D)}P\{B^{\mathrm{lo}}(t)\le\theta(t)\le B^{\mathrm{up}}(t)\text{ for every }t\in\mathcal I\}\ge1-\alpha-\varepsilon_{N_0,K_T,K_D}(\alpha)\}\). Thus admissibility is enforced at the same triple at which width is evaluated, while \(\varepsilon_{N_0,K_T,K_D}(\alpha)\) vanishes uniformly on every three-dimensional tail.

definitions.name: Explicit normalization-preserving rank-two target-loading pair
definitions.construction: Set \(x_m=\{m-(N_0+1)/2\}/\sqrt{(N_0^2-1)/12}\), so \(N_0^{-1}\sum_{m\in\mathcal D}x_m=0\), \(N_0^{-1}\sum_{m\in\mathcal D}x_m^2=1\), and \(\max_m|x_m|<\sqrt 3\). Choose the declared fixed constants \(a_{\circ,0},a_{\circ,1},\lambda_\circ,h_\circ\) in the interior of the class bounds, with \(h_\circ\) small enough for the displayed density floor. For \(u\in\{-1,+1\}\), put \(s_p(t)=e^{-\lambda_\circ t}\), \(b_p(t)=a_{\circ,p}\psi_\circ(t)\), \(z_m=x_m\) for donors, and \(z_\star^{(u)}=u h_\circ K_T^{-1/2}\). Define \(S_{p,m}^{(u)}(t)=s_p(t)+b_p(t)z_m\) on \(\mathcal I\), continue it after \(\bar\tau\) by \(S_{p,m}^{(u)}(\bar\tau)e^{-\lambda_\circ(t-\bar\tau)}\), and take \(C_{p,m,j}=\infty\). The constants are chosen so the densities \(f_{p,m}^{(u)}=-\partial_tS_{p,m}^{(u)}\) obey \(f_{p,m}^{(u)}\ge c_f\) on the support of \(\psi_\circ'\). The resulting observed-data laws are \(P_u\).

definitions.name: Rate-matched interpolation grid
definitions.construction: Choose a deterministic grid \(\mathcal G_{N_0,K_T,K_D}\) containing zero and \(\bar\tau\) whose mesh obeys \(h_{N_0,K_T,K_D}^\beta\le\rho_r(N_0,K_T,K_D)\), and use piecewise-linear interpolation between adjacent grid points.

definitions.name: Censoring-aware functional-PCR martingale-multiplier band
definitions.construction: Compute every \(\widehat S^{\mathrm{KM}}_{p,m}\) on \(\mathcal G_{N_0,K_T,K_D}\). Center the donor curves, retain the first \(d=r-1\) functional principal contrasts, estimate \(z_\star\) by minimum-norm least squares from \(\widehat S^{\mathrm{KM}}_{0,\star}-\widehat s_0\), and set \(\widehat\theta_r=\widehat s_1+\widehat b_1^\top\widehat z_\star\), with \(\widehat\theta_1=\widehat s_1\). Linearize this map jointly in all cellwise Kaplan--Meier counting-process martingales. Replace each patient martingale increment by \(\xi_{p,m,j}\) times its estimated increment, recompute the linearized target process, and take its conditional \((1-\alpha)\)-quantile in grid supremum norm. Define \(\widehat B_r\) by adding and subtracting that quantile and the deterministic interpolation allowance \(Lh_{N_0,K_T,K_D}^\beta\), interpolate linearly, clip to \([0,1]\), and impose the common endpoint value one at time zero.

definitions.name: Normalization-preserving rank-adaptation handle
definitions.construction: Use a patient-martingale estimate of the second normalized contrast singular value to test exact rank one against separated rank-two alternatives, and invert that test to switch between the rank-one and rank-two oracle multiplier bands while preserving \(S(0)=1\). The threshold and the adaptive band are to be derived from the composite testing problem rather than fixed in advance.

statements.statement: For every \(P\in\mathfrak P_1(N_0,K_T,K_D)\), the canonical contrast dimension is \(d=0\), so \(S^0_{p,m}(t)=s_p(t)\) for all units and \(\theta(t)=s_1(t)\). Along every regular submodel that perturbs \(\theta\) through the post-control law, the score contribution of the target-pre records is identically zero. Thus target-pre data are \(\theta\)-ancillary at exact rank one, while the canonical target-loading derivative is nonzero on a normalization-preserving submodel of \(\mathfrak P_r\) for every fixed \(r\ge2\).
statements.justification: This derivative calculation is the algebraic source of the discontinuous information frontier.
statements.gap: HanShah2025SSC uses an exact rank condition but does not separate the normalization direction or analyze its score degeneracy.
statements.consumer: It tells PETAL analysts when collecting more target-pre patients cannot narrow the post-control band.

statements.statement: Uniformly over \(P\in\mathfrak P_r(N_0,K_T,K_D)\) and all sequences with \(\min\{N_0,K_T,K_D\}\to\infty\), the functional-PCR estimator has an expansion in \(\ell^\infty(\mathcal I)\), \[\widehat\theta_r-\theta=\mathbf 1\{r\ge2\}K_T^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^{K_T}\phi_{T,j}+(N_0K_D)^{-1}\sum_{p,m,j}\phi_{D,p,m,j}+R_r,\qquad \|R_r\|_\infty=o_P(\rho_r),\] where the displayed sums are independent mean-zero censoring-martingale influence processes, the target process \(\phi_{T,j}\) is identically zero when \(r=1\), and the patient-multiplier analogue consistently estimates the law of the normalized supremum without a restriction on the relative growth of \(K_T\) and \(N_0K_D\).
statements.justification: The expansion composes Kaplan--Meier martingales with estimated functional singular spaces and exposes the two independent uncertainty channels.
statements.gap: DoblerPaulyScheike2019 gives survival-process multiplier validity and AgarwalShahShen2025PCR gives PCR stability, but neither differentiates a censored counterfactual PCR map.
statements.consumer: It supplies the feasible Gaussian approximation needed for simultaneous patient-level inference.

statements.statement: For all sufficiently large \(N_0\ge2\), \(K_T\), and \(K_D\), the two laws in \(\mathrm{def:rank-two-lecam-pair}\) belong to \(\mathfrak P_2(N_0,K_T,K_D)\), have \(S_{p,m}^{(u)}(0)=1\), and differ in observed law only through the \(K_T\) target-pre failure times. Their target curves obey \(\|\theta_+-\theta_-\|_\infty=2|a_{\circ,1}|h_\circ\|\psi_\circ\|_\infty K_T^{-1/2}\). Their likelihood divergence satisfies \[D_{\mathrm{KL}}(P_+\|P_-)\le K_T\int\frac{(f_{0,\star}^{(+)}-f_{0,\star}^{(-)})^2}{f_{0,\star}^{(-)}}\,dt\le\frac{4a_{\circ,0}^2h_\circ^2}{c_f}\int_0^{\bar\tau}\{\psi_\circ'(t)\}^2dt.\] A fixed sufficiently small \(h_\circ\) therefore yields uniformly bounded total variation while preserving exact total rank two, the donor contrast-spectrum bounds, the pre-contrast Gram bounds, and endpoint normalization.
statements.justification: The worked pair makes the target-pre lower-bound channel auditable at the level of survival laws and likelihood divergence.
statements.gap: CattaneoFengTitiunik2021 has a scalar two-error decomposition but no normalization-preserving censored survival-law subexperiment with exact rank control.
statements.consumer: It supplies the rank-two target-loading witness used by the minimax converse and provides a diagnostic simulation design.

statements.statement: There is a constant \(c_{\mathrm{int}}<\infty\) such that, for the interpolation rule in \(\mathrm{def:inference-grid}\), the difference between the continuous-time supremum error and its grid supremum is at most \(c_{\mathrm{int}}h_{N_0,K_T,K_D}^\beta\) uniformly over \(\mathfrak P_r\). Consequently the explicit interpolation allowance is \(O(\rho_r)\) and continuous-time honesty is not obtained by silently replacing \(\mathcal I\) with a fixed finite grid.
statements.justification: This closes the gap between finite-grid PCR theory and an honest band for the whole survival trajectory.
statements.gap: HanShah2025SSC proves a supremum over a finite evaluation set and does not price grid interpolation into coverage.
statements.consumer: It permits clinical reporting of a whole follow-up curve rather than a collection of pointwise intervals.

statements.statement: For each fixed \(r\ge1\), there is \(a_0<\infty\) such that, at every evaluated triple with \(\min\{N_0,K_T,K_D\}\ge a_0\), the band \(\widehat B_r\) belongs to \(\mathcal H_r(N_0,K_T,K_D;\alpha)\). There is a constant \(c_{\mathrm{up}}<\infty\), independent of \(N_0\), \(K_T\), and \(K_D\), such that at every such triple, \[\sup_{P\in\mathfrak P_r(N_0,K_T,K_D)}E_P[w(\widehat B_r)]\le c_{\mathrm{up}}\rho_r(N_0,K_T,K_D).\] Both assertions hold uniformly over every three-dimensional tail, with no balanced-growth or relative-rate restriction.
statements.justification: This is the implementable honest patient-level replacement for the empirical donor bootstrap.
statements.gap: HanShah2025SSC supplies only finite-grid consistency and an empirical donor-resampling interval; no existing result propagates patient martingales through estimated survival PCR factors.
statements.consumer: The PETAL Synthetic Survival Control analysis can report a valid simultaneous post-control survival band.

statements.statement: There are constants \(a_0<\infty\) and \(c_{\mathrm{low}}>0\) such that, at every evaluated triple with \(\min\{N_0,K_T,K_D\}\ge a_0\), every \(B\in\mathcal H_1(N_0,K_T,K_D;\alpha)\) satisfies \[\sup_{P\in\mathfrak P_1(N_0,K_T,K_D)}E_P[w(B)]\ge c_{\mathrm{low}}(N_0K_D)^{-1/2},\] and, for every fixed \(r\ge2\), every \(B\in\mathcal H_r(N_0,K_T,K_D;\alpha)\) satisfies \[\sup_{P\in\mathfrak P_r(N_0,K_T,K_D)}E_P[w(B)]\ge c_{\mathrm{low}}\{K_T^{-1/2}+(N_0K_D)^{-1/2}\}.\] The donor channel uses a normalization-preserving post-donor hazard pair of size \((N_0K_D)^{-1/2}\). The target channel embeds the explicit rank-two pair from \(\mathrm{lem:rank-two-pair}\) and adds fixed orthogonal contrast directions for \(r>2\). All pairs preserve valid survival laws, endpoint normalization, exact primitive rank, the nonzero contrast-spectrum and pre-contrast Gram bounds, and uniformly bounded total variation.
statements.justification: The two normalization-preserving subexperiments certify that neither surviving stochastic channel can be removed by a different estimator.
statements.gap: CattaneoFengTitiunik2021 separates two scalar prediction errors but gives neither censored functional Le Cam pairs nor the rank-one normalization degeneracy.
statements.consumer: It prevents a nominally narrow donor-only band from being advertised as honest when target-loading uncertainty is information-theoretically unavoidable.

statements.statement: For fixed \(\alpha\in(0,1/2)\) and every fixed exact rank \(r\), there is \(a_0<\infty\) such that uniformly over every evaluated triple with \(\min\{N_0,K_T,K_D\}\ge a_0\), without relative-growth restrictions, \[W_1^*(N_0,K_T,K_D;\alpha)\asymp(N_0K_D)^{-1/2},\qquad W_r^*(N_0,K_T,K_D;\alpha)\asymp K_T^{-1/2}+(N_0K_D)^{-1/2}\quad(r\ge2).\] Here each infimum is over bands satisfying the coverage constraint at that same evaluated triple.
statements.justification: This is the sharp rank-normalization phase transition in honest continuous-time information.
statements.gap: No located synthetic-control, survival-band, or low-rank inference paper states a donor-only rank-one width and a two-channel rank-at-least-two width for this causal survival curve.
statements.consumer: It gives trial and registry designers a sharp rule for whether more target-pre patients can reduce counterfactual-curve uncertainty.

statements.statement: On the homogeneous normalized special case \(r=1\), \(\widehat\theta_1\) and \(\widehat B_1\) reduce, up to the stated interpolation allowance, to the pooled donor-post Kaplan--Meier estimator and its patient-level martingale-multiplier simultaneous band based on \(N_0K_D\) observations.
statements.justification: The reduction is the required sanity check against classical one-sample survival-band theory.
statements.gap: DoblerPaulyScheike2019 validates martingale bands for survival functionals but does not derive this normalized Synthetic Survival Control reduction.
statements.consumer: It supplies a transparent implementation check for the rank-one software path.

statements.statement: Can one construct a single band without knowing \(r\) or the numerical values of the fixed positive contrast-spectrum and pre-Gram lower bounds such that, at every sufficiently large evaluated triple, it satisfies the per-triple coverage constraint simultaneously over \(\mathfrak P_1(N_0,K_T,K_D)\cup\mathfrak P_2(N_0,K_T,K_D)\) and attains the rank-one width on \(\mathfrak P_1\) and the rank-two width on \(\mathfrak P_2\)? Derive the band through the normalization-preserving singular-value test \(\mathcal A_{\mathrm{adapt}}\), and characterize the smallest unavoidable excess width caused by rank selection under the common coverage-error schedule.
statements.justification: A data-driven rank choice must confront the discontinuous oracle widths and the same finite-triple coverage standard as the oracle bands.
statements.gap: CarpentierKloppLofflerNickl2018 reduces rank adaptation to testing in matrix norms, while HanShah2025SSC selects rank without post-selection survival-band coverage or unknown-strength calibration.
statements.consumer: It determines when practitioners may select the SSC rank and still retain an oracle-width honest band.

sampling_model.design: Fixed two-period panel with one target unit observed under control only before intervention and \(N_0\) donor units observed under control in both periods.
sampling_model.units: Independent right-censored patient records within the target-pre cohort and every donor-period cohort.
sampling_model.treatment: The target receives treatment after the intervention; its missing post-control survival curve is the causal estimand, while donor exposure remains control.
sampling_model.overlap: Event and censoring survival probabilities are uniformly positive on \(\mathcal I\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The primitive centered donor survival operator has exactly \(r-1\) bounded nonzero singular directions. Cellwise Kaplan--Meier curves feed the corresponding covariance-normalized functional-PCR map, and patient-level counting-process multipliers jointly re-estimate donor and target-pre uncertainty.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorem 2 proves a finite-grid consistency rate for Kaplan--Meier PCR, and the PETAL application reports a 500-donor-bootstrap interval.
Lemma 1 combines in-sample weight uncertainty and out-of-sample prediction uncertainty into a scalar conditional prediction interval.
Theorems 4.1 and 4.2 identify the minimum-norm PCR coefficient and control fixed-design out-of-sample prediction under row-space inclusion.
The main bootstrap theorem validates time-simultaneous martingale-multiplier bands for cumulative-hazard and survival functionals.
The paper derives synthetic-control limit laws whose relevant randomness changes with unit-level and time-level confounding.
Theorems 2.1 and 2.2 connect honest rank adaptation to minimax composite testing and oracle confidence sets in matrix completion.

tldr: The project studies the entire post-control survival trajectory for a treated unit in the exact-factor Synthetic Survival Control model. Exact total rank is imposed primitively through a centered donor survival operator with exactly \(r-1\) nonzero directions and bounded contrast spectrum, which makes the covariance-normalized factor coordinates and functional PCR well defined. At exact rank one there is no target loading to estimate, so the optimal per-triple honest band has donor-patient width \((N_0K_D)^{-1/2}\); at every fixed rank at least two, target-pre loading uncertainty survives and the sharp width is \(K_T^{-1/2}+(N_0K_D)^{-1/2}\). A censoring-aware functional-PCR band attains this frontier under a deterministic coverage-error schedule that vanishes on every three-dimensional tail, while explicit normalization-preserving survival-law pairs give the matching converse without relative-growth restrictions.

project_justification.gap: Han and Shah establish identification and finite-grid consistency for Synthetic Survival Control but do not provide uniformly honest continuous-time bands, patient-level propagation through PCR, or a minimax converse; their PETAL interval resamples donors only.
project_justification.niche: Normalization \(S(0)=1\) creates a rank-specific information geometry absent from scalar synthetic-control inference: a primitive zero-rank donor contrast operator has no heterogeneous target loading, whereas every positive fixed contrast rank can carry a target-pre channel.
project_justification.fill: The project derives canonical coordinates from an exact-rank, bounded-spectrum donor operator, defines minimax width over bands constrained at each evaluated sample triple, obtains an arbitrary-relative-growth functional expansion and attaining multiplier band, and supplies matching lower bounds including an explicit rank-two target-loading pair.

related_work: HanShah2025SSC supplies the causal survival-panel setup, exact factor restriction, Kaplan--Meier first stages, and PCR consistency that motivate the target, but it does not analyze per-triple uniform coverage or minimax expected width. AgarwalShahShen2025PCR supplies the minimum-norm and row-space PCR map and its strong-factor geometry; the present class makes that geometry primitive through exact centered-operator rank and bounded nonzero spectrum. DoblerPaulyScheike2019 supplies the patient counting-process multiplier construction for time-simultaneous survival inference. CattaneoFengTitiunik2021 supplies the conceptual separation between pre-fit and post-prediction uncertainty for scalar synthetic controls, while the explicit rank-two survival pair here isolates the target-loading channel and calculates its likelihood divergence. ImbensViviano2026 shows in a different random-factor model that valid synthetic-control inference depends on which stochastic channel remains after conditioning. GoldsmithGrevenCrainiceanu2013 accounts for decomposition uncertainty in functional principal-component bands but has neither censoring nor a causal missing curve. CarpentierKloppLofflerNickl2018 informs the open rank-adaptation question through its testing reduction. CurthPoonNoriGonzalez2024 and AtheyBayatiDoudchenkoImbensKhosravi2021 motivate, but are not theorem-level targets of, the separate approximate-rank extension.
technical_internal_limitation: The lower frontier is minimax over an exact-rank class. It does not claim that every individual rank-at-least-two law has a nonzero target-pre variance component; a particular law with a vanishing post contrast can be easier. Exact rank is also not an approximation-bias guarantee, so approximate-rank robustness remains a distinct proposal angle.
honest_scope: The closed claims concern known fixed total rank defined by a primitive centered donor operator, exactly \(r-1\) nonzero contrast directions with uniform lower and upper spectrum bounds, independent right censoring, a fixed follow-up horizon, smooth hazards, and patient sampling in the target-pre and donor cells. Honesty is imposed at every evaluated sample triple with a fixed deterministic coverage-error allowance that vanishes uniformly on three-dimensional tails. The exact rank-one reduction recovers the classical pooled donor-post survival band. Unknown-rank adaptation remains an open-ended composite-testing question, and covariate-dependent censoring is reserved for a separate efficiency problem.
